name: Gridgets
description:
GNOME widgets for your desktop.
* Place clock, weather, notes, music, system monitor, clipboard and image widgets on a desktop grid.
* Local clipboard history widget.
* Drag, resize, and customise each widget independently.
* Reads the clipboard for the clipboard history widget, and writes to it only when you invoke Cut, Copy or Paste on a desktop icon. Those shortcuts are unbound by default, because extensions.gnome.org does not allow an extension to ship default clipboard shortcuts; bind them yourself with dconf Editor under /org/gnome/shell/extensions/gridgets/.
